subject.title: feat: add chain-of-thought pre-flight planning for long-running goals

question: Should OpenClaw add persistent, model-mutable goal-plan state and two new goal-plan tools to core, or should long-running execution planning remain on the existing `update_plan` path?
rationale: This is a new core session-state and configuration contract, not a repair of an established behavior; choosing the permanent planning and persistence boundary requires owner intent.

options.title: Keep the existing plan surface
options.body: Do not add persisted goal-plan state; use the established `update_plan` workflow for execution planning.

options.title: Sponsor a bounded core design
options.body: Approve a documented session-goal plan contract, then require strict config wiring, policy-gated tools, migration/retention behavior, and focused upgrade proof.

options.title: Move optional planning outside core
options.body: Provide the workflow as an optional skill or plugin if it does not need a new core session-goal API.

recommendation.title: Keep the existing plan surface
recommendation.body: Do not add persisted goal-plan state; use the established `update_plan` workflow for execution planning.

likelyOwner.reason: The earlier core session-goals work is the closest identified ownership trail for the persisted contract this PR proposes to extend.
